name: Understand the Dev & Supply
question: What am I buying into—and what can the supply side do?
intro: Start with bundles and visible wallets. Learn issuance, control, sellable supply, liquidity, earnings, and the dev–buyer relationship through practical checks.
principle: See both sides: test the demand thesis and the hygiene of supply. Structural checks reduce blind spots; they do not guarantee market demand.
